beats.text: Ever faked it? You are far from the only one.
Researchers asked almost three hundred college students if they had ever pretended to orgasm.
Among those who'd had intercourse, two out of three women said yes.
And men? More than one in four. Yes, men too.
The top reasons: it just wasn't going to happen, they wanted it to end, or they didn't want to hurt their partner's feelings.
So it's usually about kindness, not deception. But talking beats performing.

sources: Muehlenhard & Shippee (2010). Men's and women's reports of pretending orgasm. Journal of Sex Research 47(6). 180 men, 101 women (college students); 25% of men, 50% of women had pretended; among those with penile-vaginal intercourse experience 28% of men, 67% of women. Reasons: orgasm unlikely, wanting sex to end, avoiding negative outcomes (hurting partner's feelings), pleasing partner. Via PubMed 19707929.
